components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific/title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned: on create it holds the
            composed, normalized address — equal to the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat
            input when only 'address' was supplied. Optional on input: an owner
            is valid when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'), plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            Optional first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present
            (non-blank); it is normalized on create — trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded
            (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE) — and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
            When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and 8 to 15 digits are required after the '+'. When a country
            code is given explicitly the national-number length must match that
            country ('+61' requires 9 national digits, '+1' requires 10), else the
            request is rejected with 400. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned
            as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); an out-of-range
            postcode is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Optional when absent; stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only create flag. The householdId is derived deterministically
            from lastName and postcode, so an owner whose lastName and postcode
            match an existing owner is the same household. When true, such a second
            member is admitted and is not flagged as a possible duplicate;
            otherwise the request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a space and the
                last name when a title is present, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains E.164.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' (no separators): REGION is the region
                code derived from the postcode (NSW, VIC, QLD, otherwise UNKNOWN);
                FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starting 1 July); HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Unifies the former customerCode,
                membershipNumber and checkDigit.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 2 Jul 2025 -> FY26).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                lastName and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
                postcode resolve to the same value automatically. Null for owners
                with no postcode, who are a household of one.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's
                whole identityKey equals an existing owner's, so two owners with
                the same last name and postcode but different telephones are both
                allowed (and instead flagged possibleDuplicate).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was registered sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero for a distinctly named owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, adds 2 when an email
                is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2 for a household
                of 3 or more, and adds 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year (the fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5,
                and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's business day at the time of registration, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 other
                owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate,
                the email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label
                matches a known disposable email service, e.g. a different TLD or
                a subdomain of a blocked domain), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds 40 or more other owners). Otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' relative to the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id}
                sets this true and retains the record; the owner is still returned
                by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity
                checks. False for a newly created owner.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific/title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned: on create it holds the
            composed, normalized address — equal to the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat
            input when only 'address' was supplied. Optional on input: an owner
            is valid when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'), plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            Optional first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present
            (non-blank); it is normalized on create — trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded
            (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE) — and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
            When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and 8 to 15 digits are required after the '+'. When a country
            code is given explicitly the national-number length must match that
            country ('+61' requires 9 national digits, '+1' requires 10), else the
            request is rejected with 400. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned
            as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); an out-of-range
            postcode is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Optional when absent; stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only create flag. The householdId is derived deterministically
            from lastName and postcode, so an owner whose lastName and postcode
            match an existing owner is the same household. When true, such a second
            member is admitted and is not flagged as a possible duplicate;
            otherwise the request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a space and the
                last name when a title is present, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains E.164.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner-identity API version for this response. Always 2 under
                identity-v2, which groups the identifiers under 'identity' and
                rederives them with the version-2 region code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 2 Jul 2025 -> FY26).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                lastName and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
                postcode resolve to the same value automatically. Null for owners
                with no postcode, who are a household of one.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's
                whole identityKey equals an existing owner's, so two owners with
                the same last name and postcode but different telephones are both
                allowed (and instead flagged possibleDuplicate).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was registered sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero for a distinctly named owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1

            registrationDate (the fiscal year starting 1 July); HASH8 is the first
            eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the version-2 region
            code, the normalized (E.164) telephone and the lastName; and CHK is a
            single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string

          title: Household ID

            normalized lastName and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
            postcode resolve to the same value automatically. Null for owners with

            flagged possibleDuplicate).

          readOnly: true
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific/title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned: on create it holds the
            composed, normalized address — equal to the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat
            input when only 'address' was supplied. Optional on input: an owner
            is valid when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'), plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            Optional first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present
            (non-blank); it is normalized on create — trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded
            (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE) — and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
            When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and 8 to 15 digits are required after the '+'. When a country
            code is given explicitly the national-number length must match that
            country ('+61' requires 9 national digits, '+1' requires 10), else the
            request is rejected with 400. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned
            as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); an out-of-range
            postcode is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Optional when absent; stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only create flag. The householdId is derived deterministically
            from lastName and postcode, so an owner whose lastName and postcode
            match an existing owner is the same household. When true, such a second
            member is admitted and is not flagged as a possible duplicate;
            otherwise the request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a space and the
                last name when a title is present, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains E.164.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner-identity API version for this response. Always 2 under
                identity-v2, which groups the identifiers under 'identity' and
                rederives them with the version-2 region code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 2 Jul 2025 -> FY26).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was registered sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero for a distinctly named owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, adds 2 when an email
                is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2 for a household
                of 3 or more, and adds 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year (the fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5,
                and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's business day at the time of registration, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 other
                owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate,
                the email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label
                matches a known disposable email service, e.g. a different TLD or
                a subdomain of a blocked domain), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds 40 or more other owners). Otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' relative to the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id}
                sets this true and retains the record; the owner is still returned
                by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity
                checks. False for a newly created owner.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

I released version 2 of the owner identity. The change centers on a new **version-2 region code** — the plain region combined with a fixed `V2` tag — mixed *inside* the identifier derivations while the user-facing region stays plain.

**Version-2 region code** (`PostcodeRegions`)

- `OwnerIdentity.identityKey` — now hashes `regionCodeV2 | telephone | email | soundex(lastName)`; both sides of the duplicate check canonicalize identically, so 409 detection stays consistent.

**V2 tag stays out of user-facing fields** — `locality`, `timezone` and `ownerSegment` all derive from the plain region (via the memberId's plain prefix), so the `V2` tag never surfaces there.

**Response shape** (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper`)

- Added top-level integer `apiVersion: 2`.

**Audit** (`AuditOwnerCreated`)
- Structured event moved to schema version 2: added `schemaVersion: 2` and an `ownerSegment` recomputed from the version-2 identity.

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) are unchanged.

The new acceptance test confirms the contract: `apiVersion == 2`, `identity.{memberId,identityKey,householdId}` present, and those three no longer exist at the top level.
